lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance, circular pixel clusters are organized into approximately vertical columns and horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits. The spacing between centroids increases slightly along the longitudinal axis towards the posterior.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of spots, particularly visible in the mid-flank region, creating a grid-like pattern of anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal ridges are visible across the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp luminance transition from a light dorsal edge to a shadowed ventral edge.
